issue.title: Say on each page of the reports list whether there is a next page
issue.body:
Our sync tool reads `GET /reports` page by page. Right now the only ways to know
we've reached the last page are to work it out from `total` and `pageSize`, or
to ask for one more page and get an empty `items` list back. People keep
creating reports while the tool runs, so `total` moves between requests and the
tool sometimes stops a page early. Could each page also carry the page count,
or a flag saying whether another page follows?

input.title: Add hasNextPage and pageCount to paginated list responses
input.body:
File: src/util/pagination.ts

Extend toPage so every page also carries `pageCount` (using the existing pageCount helper) and a `hasNextPage` flag (params.offset + items.length < total). GET /reports uses toPage, so the sync tool can stop on `hasNextPage: false`. The Page<T> type in src/types.ts and docs/API.md need the new fields as well.

This is a request for new behaviour. toPage in src/util/pagination.ts builds the paginated response that GET /reports returns, so that is where `hasNextPage` and `pageCount` would be added. parsePage also rejects a pageSize above 100 with a validation error, so the tool can't read every report in one request. I opened a draft PR (pr-13) that proposes the change. It would also need the Page type in src/types.ts and docs/API.md updated.
